from pathlib import Path
import json, re, sys, hashlib
from pdfminer.high_level import extract_pages
from pdfminer.layout import LTTextLine, LTContainer, LAParams
import pdfminer

PDF = Path('/tmp/held-resolution-schools/independent-sd8-public-agenda-2026-09-08.pdf')
PAGES = list(range(185,194))

def walk(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, LTTextLine):
        yield obj
    elif isinstance(obj, LTContainer):
        for child in obj:
            yield from walk(child)

def amount(text):
    text = text.replace('$', '').strip()
    if text in ('', '-', '–', '—'):
        return None
    assert re.fullmatch(r'-?\(?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?\)?', text), text
    negative = text.startswith('(')
    value = float(text.replace(',', '').strip('()'))
    value = -value if negative else value
    return int(value) if value == int(value) else value

rows, row_evidence, pages = [], [], []
for pg, layout in zip(PAGES, extract_pages(str(PDF), page_numbers=[n-1 for n in PAGES], laparams=LAParams(char_margin=2, word_margin=0.1, line_margin=0.3, boxes_flow=None, all_texts=True))):
    # all_texts=True is essential: salary cells occur inside Form XObjects.
    lines = [{'bbox': list(line.bbox), 'text': line.get_text().strip()} for line in sorted(walk(layout), key=lambda x:(-x.y0,x.x0)) if line.get_text().strip()]
    top = 467 if pg == 185 else 660
    pay_min, pay_max = (350,420) if pg == 185 else (370,445)
    exp_min, exp_max = (445,500) if pg == 185 else (470,523)
    names = [line for line in lines if 80 < line['bbox'][0] < 110 and line['bbox'][2] < 340 and 40 < line['bbox'][1] < top and re.fullmatch(r'[^0-9,]+,\s*[^0-9,]+',line['text'])]
    headers = [line for line in lines if line['bbox'][1] > 710]
    assert any('June 30, 2026' in line['text'] for line in headers), pg
    for name in names:
        baseline = name['bbox'][1]
        band = [line for line in lines if abs(line['bbox'][1]-baseline) < 0.75]
        money = [line for line in band if pay_min < line['bbox'][0] < pay_max and re.fullmatch(r'-?\(?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?\)?',line['text'])]
        expense = [line for line in band if exp_min < line['bbox'][0] < exp_max and re.fullmatch(r'-|–|—|-?\(?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?\)?',line['text'])]
        assert len(money) == len(expense) == 1, (pg,name,money,expense)
        row = ['school-district-08',name['text'],None,amount(money[0]['text']),amount(expense[0]['text']),pg]
        rows.append(row)
        row_evidence.append({'row':row,'sourceRowOnPage':len([v for v in rows if v[5]==pg]),'nameCell':name,'payCell':money[0],'expenseCell':expense[0],'literalExpenseToken':expense[0]['text'],'footnoteCells':[line for line in band if line['bbox'][0]>523 and '*' in line['text']]})
    pages.append({'physicalPage':pg,'headerLines':headers,'employeeRows':len(names),'pdfminerLines':lines})
assert len(rows)==340, len(rows)
assert [v['employeeRows'] for v in pages]==[27,41,41,41,41,41,41,41,26]
